$comment: Prompts for tools/generate-art.mjs (Retro Diffusion). Each kind has its style, size and the approved sprites used as style references (art/references/<kind>/<id>.png). Approved sprites go to src/client/art/<kind>/<id>.png.

prompts.wolf: lean grey wolf with amber eyes, snarling, full body, three-quarter view
prompts.alpha-wolf: huge dark grey alpha wolf with a scarred muzzle, glowing red eyes and raised hackles, full body, three-quarter view
prompts.fox: red fox with a bushy white-tipped tail and black legs, full body, three-quarter view
prompts.lynx: Eurasian lynx with tufted ears, spotted tawny fur and a short black-tipped tail, crouching to pounce, full body, three-quarter view
prompts.bear: massive brown bear on all fours, mouth open in a roar, full body, three-quarter view
prompts.boar: wild boar with dark bristly fur and curved white tusks, head lowered to charge, full body, three-quarter view
prompts.badger: European badger with a black and white striped face and grey fur, full body, three-quarter view
prompts.crow: black raven with ruffled feathers and a heavy beak, wings half spread, full body, three-quarter view
prompts.owl: tawny owl with big dark eyes and mottled brown feathers, perched on a short branch, full body, front view
prompts.viper: coiled European adder with a dark zigzag stripe, head raised and forked tongue out, full body
prompts.spider: large European garden spider with a white cross on its brown abdomen and eight hairy legs, full body, top-down three-quarter view
prompts.wisp: will-o'-the-wisp, a floating pale cyan ghost flame with two faint eyes, glowing, trailing wisps of light
prompts.likho: Likho, a gaunt one-eyed Slavic forest demon with grey skin, a single huge eye, long claws and tattered rags, hunched, full body, three-quarter view

prompts.warrior-male: young man warrior standing, full body from head to feet, dented iron helmet and chainmail, a round wooden shield and a sword, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, forest fantasy
prompts.warrior-female: young woman warrior standing, full body from head to feet, dented iron helmet and chainmail, a round wooden shield and a sword, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, forest fantasy
prompts.archer-male: young man archer standing, full body from head to feet, dark green hood and leather jacket, holding a longbow, a quiver of arrows on the back, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, forest fantasy
prompts.archer-female: young woman archer standing, full body from head to feet, dark green hood and leather jacket, holding a longbow, a quiver of arrows on the back, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, forest fantasy
prompts.mage-male: young man mage standing, full body from head to feet, long blue robe, holding a gnarled staff with a glowing cyan crystal, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, forest fantasy
prompts.mage-female: young woman mage standing, full body from head to feet, long blue robe, holding a gnarled staff with a glowing cyan crystal, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, forest fantasy
prompts.cleric-male: young man cleric standing, full body from head to feet, white and gold robe with a holy symbol, holding a silver aspergillum and a round shield, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, forest fantasy
prompts.cleric-female: young woman cleric standing in the middle of the image, small full body figure from the top of the head to the leather boots, empty space above the head and below the feet, white and gold robe reaching the ankles with a holy symbol, holding a silver aspergillum and a round shield, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, forest fantasy
prompts.shadow-male: young man rogue standing, full body from head to feet, black hood and a mask over the mouth, holding two daggers, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, forest fantasy
prompts.shadow-female: young woman rogue standing, full body from head to feet, black hood and a mask over the mouth, holding two daggers, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, forest fantasy
